search_notes: ANGLeD: no result found by NCT, acronym, ANG1005 (paclitaxel trevatide) or Angiochem in a web search and PubMed; no company release, abstract or paper. Registry status unknown, not updated since Apr 2023 (was active, not recruiting); a site page says the study is closed. Angiochem is private with no investor page found. Whether the trial completed or was abandoned is not stated anywhere I could find. Light search.

MATTERHORN. AstraZeneca high-level results release of 7 Mar 2025 (also filed as a 6-K the same day): statistically significant EFS improvement at a planned interim analysis, OS trend, no numbers. SEC full-text search shows no earlier AstraZeneca filing stating the result (the 20-F of 18 Feb 2025 predates it). HR first public 1 June 2025 with the ASCO 2025 plenary and simultaneous NEJM paper (PMID 40454643). Final OS reported later (Lancet, Sept 2026).

HS-10241-301 (dalmelitinib, HS-10241, plus aumolertinib). No statement of the phase 3 primary result found: web search, PubMed, Crossref, and Hansoh HKEX documents read (2025 annual results 29 Mar 2026; 2026 interim results 26 Aug 2026). CAUTION: Hansoh announced on 27 Feb 2026 that the NMPA accepted the NDA for dalmelitinib plus aumolertinib in exactly this population (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0227/2026022701558.pdf), but neither that notice nor the results documents say which study supports it or give any phase 3 outcome; the only data Hansoh cites are the single-arm phase 1b (ELCC, Mar 2026). The filing may rest on this trial. Registry stale since Nov 2023 (not yet recruiting). Chinese-language press not searched in depth.

which_endpoint: rPFS by investigator (BRCA subgroup, HRR-effector subgroup and all HRR, tested in sequence)
search_notes: AMPLITUDE. Johnson & Johnson release of 3 June 2025 with the ASCO 2025 oral (LBA5006), read in a repost; described as first results; no earlier topline found, and SEC full-text search finds no J&J filing naming AMPLITUDE with niraparib/Akeega between Jan and June 2025. HR cells are the all-HRR population (0.63, 0.49-0.80, p=0.0001); BRCA subgroup 0.52 (0.37-0.72). Registry later posted 0.625 (0.490-0.799) and 0.515 (0.370-0.717); HRR-effector 0.571. Nature Medicine paper 7 Oct 2025 (PMID 41057655). J&J quarterly pipeline PDFs were not opened.

which_endpoint: PuFS (registry primary) and OS (dual primary per abstract)
search_notes: COREMAP (Simcere, Endostar plus intracavitary cisplatin). Only result found is ESMO GI 2026 abstract 673P (Ann Oncol suppl, doi 10.1016/j.annonc.2026.05.202), titled final analysis, cutoff 10 Feb 2025: dual primary endpoints OS and PuFS; 'no statistically significant difference in PuFS'; OS median 7.8 vs 5.6 mo, HR 0.807 (0.625-1.042), Peto P=0.0338, called 'clinically meaningful', with no statement that OS met its significance boundary. HR CELLS ARE FOR OS, NOT PuFS (no PuFS HR given). On the registry's single primary endpoint (PuFS) this is not_met; coded unclear because the abstract names OS as a second primary and hints at success without stating it. Date is the Crossref deposit date; the congress was in early July 2026 (not verified), so the true date is probably about two weeks earlier. Simcere's 2025 annual results (25 Mar 2026) and 2026 interim results say only that the NDA for thoracoabdominal effusions was accepted in Feb 2026, with no result; 2024 annual results give last patient in Nov 2024. An earlier Chinese-language disclosure is possible.

MIL62-CT301 (MIL62 plus lenalidomide vs lenalidomide, rituximab-refractory FL). No result found by NCT, study number or MIL62 in a web search, PubMed or Crossref; only the single-arm phase 1b/2 is published (EClinicalMedicine 2024, PMID 39007066). Registry says recruiting, last updated Nov 2024. Beijing Mabworks is unlisted; its own news page and Chinese-language press were not searched. Light search.

which_endpoint: RFS (dual primary with OS; OS not formally tested)
search_notes: KEYNOTE-937. First disclosed as one sentence in Merck's Q2 2025 results release (8-K exhibit, 29 July 2025): 'a pre-specified interim analysis of the Phase 3 KEYNOTE-937 study found that compared to placebo, KEYTRUDA did not show a statistically significant improvement in the primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival for certain patients with hepatocellular carcinoma'. No stand-alone release; SEC full-text search shows no Merck filing naming KEYNOTE-937 earlier in 2025 (Q1 release silent). HR first shown at ASCO GI 2026 (coverage dated 9 Jan 2026): RFS HR 1.06 (0.88-1.26), P=.719; same HR on the registry (posted 2026-04-24), OS HR 1.08 (0.81-1.43).

EMPOWER-Lung 1 (R2810-ONC-1624). Sanofi/Regeneron release of 27 Apr 2020 (read as Sanofi 6-K exhibit): OS met at a protocol-specified interim analysis and, on the IDMC's recommendation to stop the trial early, all patients were offered cemiplimab; HR 0.676 (0.525-0.870), p=0.002, given in the release. Registry lists OS and PFS as primaries and carries an actual primary completion date of 2025-04-18 (final database lock), five years after the readout; registry final OS HR 0.661 (0.553-0.790), PFS 0.559. ESMO 2020 and Lancet 2021 report the PD-L1>=50% population (OS HR 0.57).

AdvanTIG-302. BeiGene (now BeOne) release of 3 Apr 2025: IDMC recommended termination at a pre-planned futility analysis, trial unlikely to meet OS; no numbers. This is 8 weeks before the registry primary completion date (2025-05-30, the cutoff of the terminal analysis). HR first public as ESMO Immuno-Oncology Congress 2025 abstract 244MO (descriptive, no formal test); date is the Crossref deposit date of the abstract, the congress itself was about two weeks earlier in Dec 2025 (not verified). Same HR on the registry (posted 2026-05-12) and in J Thorac Oncol (14 July 2026, PMID 42448175).

which_endpoint: OS (arm A vs C and arm B vs C)
search_notes: COSTAR Lung. Disclosed only inside the GSK Q2 2025 results announcement (6-K, 30 July 2025): 'In July 2025, the phase III COSTAR Lung trial found that cobolimab, dostarlimab, and docetaxel combinations (triplet and doublet) did not meet the primary endpoint of improving overall survival'; the pipeline table lists it only as 'Phase III data readout'. No stand-alone release found; the Q1 2025 announcement (30 Apr 2025) still listed the readout as anticipated in H1 2025. HR cells are arm A (triplet) vs docetaxel; arm B vs docetaxel 0.96 (0.77-1.20). HR first public as ESMO Immuno-Oncology Congress 2025 abstract 241MO, dated here by its Crossref deposit (congress about two weeks earlier, not verified); same values on the registry (posted 2026-07-01).

FORTITUDE-101. Amgen topline release of 30 June 2025: met OS at a pre-specified interim analysis (the primary analysis), no numbers; Amgen's Q1 2025 release (1 May 2025) still said readout anticipated in Q2 2025. On 4 Sept 2025 Amgen/Zai Lab said the benefit had attenuated at a descriptive follow-up analysis. HR 0.61 (0.43-0.86), P=0.005 at the primary analysis and 0.82 (0.62-1.08) at follow-up were presented at ESMO in Oct 2025; the earliest source I opened with the numbers is Amgen's Q3 2025 release of 4 Nov 2025, so hr_first_public_date is about two to three weeks late.

FIGHT-302. TREAT WITH CARE: the trial was closed early for lack of enrolment after the standard of care changed (167 randomised; registry 'terminated'), yet a PFS analysis was reported. First seen in the ASCO 2026 abstract 4017 (coverage dated 21 May 2026, abstract release day; oral 1 June 2026; JCO paper epub 1 June 2026, PMID 42223137): median PFS 8.3 vs 6.8 mo, HR 0.58 (0.39-0.87), P=.0078. Coverage calls it statistically significant; the JCO abstract calls the P value nominal, i.e. an underpowered analysis without formal alpha control. Coded met on the reported HR and CI; could be argued as terminated_no_analysis or unclear. Registry results (posted 2026-08-11) give the same HR. Incyte's 10-K/10-Q stopped naming FIGHT-302 after July 2025; no Incyte topline release found.

KRT-232-118 (navtemadlin maintenance, TP53 wild-type endometrial cancer; ENGOT/GOG). No result found by NCT, study number or navtemadlin + endometrial in PubMed, Crossref or SEC full-text search; Kartos is private. Registry says recruiting, not updated since May 2024; the 2025-08 date most likely relates to Part 1 dose selection. Light search: no web search was possible for this row and the Kartos, ENGOT and GOG pages were not opened.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (dual primary with OS; OS later not met)
search_notes: LEAP-012. PFS met at the first interim analysis, presented in the ESMO 2024 Presidential Symposium (LBA3): HR 0.66 (0.51-0.84), P=.0002; OS HR 0.80 not significant. DATE: 14 Sept 2024 is the session date from an Eisai notice seen in a search summary; the article I opened is dated 16 Sept 2024. No earlier topline found: SEC full-text search shows Merck's first filing naming LEAP-012 is the Q3 2024 release (31 Oct 2024); Eisai's quarterly materials were not opened. Coded met because one of two primaries was met; on 29 Oct 2025 Merck and Eisai said OS did not reach significance and the study would close (registry: terminated, business reasons; final OS HR 0.98, 0.76-1.26). Registry primary completion date is 11 months after the PFS readout. Lancet paper 8 Jan 2025.

KN-BCG-III (Chengdu CoenBiotech BCG, NMIBC). No result found by NCT in PubMed; registry status unknown, not updated since Feb 2024, primary endpoint is 1-year RFS so the 2025-09 estimate may be optimistic. The sponsor is a small unlisted company. Light search: no web search was possible for this row; Chinese-language sources, CDE and the sponsor's site were not searched.

REGAL (galinpepimut-S). Not read out. SELLAS Q2 2026 results release (8-K exhibit, 11 Aug 2026): the final analysis will be conducted after the 80th event, which the company will announce; it remains blinded. 78 events as of 11 May 2026 (Q1 release, seen in a search summary). SEC full-text search shows no SELLAS filing naming galinpepimut after 11 Aug 2026 up to 9 Oct 2026. The earlier interim analyses (IDMC: continue) are not a primary readout.

eXalt3 (ensartinib vs crizotinib). Pre-planned interim analysis presented at the IASLC WCLC 2020 Virtual Presidential Symposium on 8 Aug 2020: BIRC PFS HR 0.51 (0.35-0.72), P=.0001 in the ITT population; JAMA Oncology 2 Sept 2021 (PMID 34473194). No earlier Xcovery release found; partner Betta Pharmaceuticals' Shenzhen notice is reported as dated 9 Aug 2020 (search summary only), i.e. after the presentation. Registry still carries an estimated primary completion date of 2025-12-30, more than five years after the readout.

HC1702-004 (CSPC liposomal cytarabine-daunorubicin bridging study vs 7+3, OS primary). No result found: PubMed, Crossref, CSPC HKEX announcement titles Dec 2023 to Oct 2026 (none names the product), and CSPC results documents read. The 2025 interim and annual results say only that 'In April 2025, the database lock was completed for bioequivalence clinical trials conducted in China' for this product in untreated elderly AML, with no outcome; whether that refers to this study is not clear. Registry status unknown, not updated since Dec 2023. Non-inferiority-style bridging design: flag for exclusion review.

SHR-A1811-309 (trastuzumab rezetecan, HER2-positive CRC; later called HORIZON-CRC01). First disclosure is a Hengrui SSE notice (no. 2026-024, republished on HKEX 10 Feb 2026, Chinese only) that the NMPA accepted the filing with priority review: the randomised phase 3 vs standard therapy showed significantly prolonged IRC-assessed PFS, OS trend, no numbers. The notice gives no protocol or NCT number; matched by design, population and endpoint, and confirmed by ASCO 2026 abstract 3505, which cites NCT06199973 (130 patients, cutoff 31 Oct 2025): HR 0.33 (0.21-0.53), published online 27 May 2026. Approved in China in Aug 2026. Registry still shows an estimated primary completion of 2026-04 (taken as the 15th), after the readout. A CDE priority-review listing a few days before 10 Feb is possible.

SHR2554-301 (zeprumetostat vs chidamide, r/r PTCL). No phase 3 result found: web search, PubMed, and all Hengrui filing-acceptance notices on HKEX from Aug 2025 to Oct 2026 read (none concerns this trial). Zeprumetostat was approved in China in 2025 on single-arm data; Hengrui's 2026 interim results (19 Aug 2026) list it without a phase 3 readout. Registry says recruiting (updated Jan 2026).

HX008-III-CRC-01 (pucotenlimab, first-line MSI-H/dMMR mCRC). Not read out: Lepu Biopharma's 2026 interim results (HKEX, 19 Aug 2026) say 'We are conducting confirmatory Phase III clinical studies on the first-line MSI-H/dMMR metastatic colorectal cancer'; no Lepu announcement title since Jan 2026 concerns it. Nothing in a web search or PubMed. Registry active, not recruiting (updated May 2026), estimated primary completion 2026-06-30. Co-developer HanX Biopharmaceuticals' pages were not searched.

R3767-ONC-2055 (fianlimab + cemiplimab vs pembrolizumab, adjuvant melanoma). Not read out. Regeneron 10-Q of 30 July 2026: the study 'passed both pre-planned interim analyses conducted by Independent Data Monitoring Committee; study will continue to final analysis', results expected in Q4 2026. SEC full-text search shows no filing naming fianlimab between 1 Aug and 9 Oct 2026. Do not confuse with the first-line metastatic trial (NCT05352672), which missed its primary endpoint in May 2026.

BL-B01D1-306 (PANKU-Breast01, iza-bren). Sichuan Biokin SSE voluntary announcement no. 2026-061, dated 26 Aug 2026 (Chinese; PDF created 25 Aug, so it may have been posted the previous evening): the iDMC judged that the PFS primary endpoint was met at the pre-specified interim analysis; names protocol BL-B01D1-306; no numbers. No HR public yet (none found in Crossref or coverage). Registry estimated primary completion 2026-08 taken as the 15th. Do not confuse with BL-B01D1-307 (PANKU-Breast02, TNBC) or the newer PANKU-Breast03.

frontMIND. Incyte topline release of 5 Jan 2026 gave the result with numbers: met PFS by investigator, HR 0.75 (0.59-0.96), p=0.019; EFS also met. Full data at ASCO 2026 with simultaneous Lancet paper (30 May 2026, PMID 42217458) and at the EHA 2026 plenary. Incyte 10-Qs of July and Oct 2025 name the trial; they were not opened, and are assumed to be forward-looking. Registry still shows an estimated primary completion of 2026-09-01, eight months after the readout. Sibling trial inMIND (follicular lymphoma) read out in 2024.

BRUIN CLL-322. Lilly topline release of 13 Apr 2026 (Lilly's page not opened; read through OncLive, same day, and CancerNetwork, 14 Apr): statistically significant IRC-assessed PFS improvement, no numbers. It was a prespecified interim analysis (cutoff 2 Feb 2026). HR presented at EHA 2026 as late-breaker LB5001; the coverage opened is dated 14 June 2026, the session day within 11-14 June is not confirmed. Lancet paper 9 July 2026 (PMID 42425121). SEC full-text search finds no Lilly filing naming CLL-322 in 2026; Lilly's Q1 2026 results documents were not opened. Registry estimated primary completion 2026-10 taken as the 15th, six months after the readout.
